data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2020 were GBP 1,683.739m. During 2020 there was an overall adverse prioryear runoff deviation (net) of GBP 20.059m (treated here as a strengthening of reserves), driven by adverse development in a number of classes including large single losses in Reinsurance and Energy and adverse development in delegated underwriting; the year was also impacted by natural catastrophe frequency (notably hurricanes) and COVID19 related claims. No explicit gross prioryear movement note was found in the statements, so the movement reported above is taken from the reported runoff deviation (net) table and is therefore a net figure and used as a fallback.
raw_causal_phrases: An (adverse)/ favourable run-off deviation was experienced during the year in respect of the following classes of business:

Where development has been adverse, this has been due to single large losses in business units such as Reinsurance and Energy or adverse development on business written outside of the current underwriting year, as has been the case in our delegated underwriting portfolio.
Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 84.9m on a net basis, adding 9.8% to the net loss ratio

Catastrophe experience in the year was far heavier than 2019 and whilst no single loss would be considered market changing on its own, there was a marked increase in the frequency of events contributing nearly 5% to the net claims ratio.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was located in the extracts. The report provides a run-off deviation table which is presented net of reinsurance; that net total (reported as '(20,059)' in the note) has been used as a fallback to quantify prior-year development and interpreted as a GBP 20.059m adverse movement (strengthening). Parentheses in the run-off table have been interpreted per the report's '(adverse)/ favourable' wording (parentheses = deficit = adverse = strengthening). As this is a net figure, it may understate the gross movement; flagging that the prior_year_development_gbp_m is NET of reinsurance because no gross figure was located. Claims development triangle was not found in the provided extracts (or was not unambiguously available), so triangle-based validation could not be performed. The line-by-line run-off amounts used for lob_movements are net and therefore approximate; confidence for those breakdowns is reduced.
